notes.title: AFTER 3 YEARS
notes.notes:
[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/ae19de4aa9b4a28f17538c8c66b4eb60/tumblr_omyz90gi0V1spvd2xo2_r2_540.png[/img]

IT'S FINALLY OUT...!!

3 years after IGMC 2014, it's finally out...!!
Seeing my first game's Steam store page is an unbelievably surreal feeling.
I can't believe it. Wow. Wow.

I'm a little emotional just looking at it.

When Antagonist won 1st place in the RPG Category in IGMC 2014, I remember how much in awe I was at that moment too. For something I created to get recognized to that extent, man, that was the single happiest moment of my life thus far.

It's been a long procrastinatey 3 years, and the length of the game sure doesn't justify 3 years worth of development (it really is more like a couple of months of serious development), but if not for the number of times I scrapped the things I experimented with, I don't think I would've been as happy with what it is now. I wanted to make it a lot bigger though...!

I have lots of people to thank for helping be take my my first few steps as a game developer, working on this project and finally completing it.

Haha, maybe this is a bit too much, it's not like I just won an Oscar or anything.
But still...

I hope that I've made something fun for all of you.

Please enjoy my first fully completed game, Antagonist, and thank you!
